measurements.scope: Approximate circumpolar path; source calls it the longest wind-driven current.

NASA/JPL's 2019 overview says the Antarctic Circumpolar Current spans about 13,000 miles (21,000 km). It does not specify a reference streamline or contour, so this alternate whole-current approximation is retained separately from the ranked 25,000 km research estimate.
measurements.source_locator: NASA/JPL article, paragraph beginning The Antarctic Circumpolar Current flows in a loop (13,000 miles / 21,000 km)

widths.boundary_rule: Source-defined SAF to SACCF meridional separation at 144 degrees W, MDT contours [-0.1, -1.0] m; no adopted velocity cutoff.
widths.extraction_method: Approximate quantity transcribed from original p4517; selected methods and Figure 5 visually reviewed. No contour-coordinate extraction or recomputation.
widths.geographic_scope: Udintsev Fracture Zone entrance at 144 degrees W; local meridional contour separation.
widths.layer: Surface geostrophic climatological MDT contour support; no fixed-depth width slab. Hydrographic and bottom-referenced transport layers are separate.
widths.name: Antarctic Circumpolar Current

original_regional_context.display_aria_label: Antarctic Circumpolar Current: approximately 170 kilometres, major-front separation between SAF and SACCF. Local meridional MDT contour separation at Udintsev, 144 degrees west, climatological reference period 1993 to 2012. Not a whole-current width or seasonal range. Numerical uncertainty and exact paired geographic edges unknown.
original_regional_context.display_caption: Approximately 170 km · Major-front separation (SAF–SACCF) at Udintsev, 144°W. Separate from the 500 km quantity; no pooled 170–500 km interval. Numerical uncertainty unknown.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: CNES-CLS18 MDT reference period 1993–2012; boundary contours [-0.1, -1.0] m. Figure 5 uses meridional separation; exact paired geographic coordinates not extracted. Cruise months, Argo validation, grid spacing and transport do not define width dates, depth or uncertainty. No seasonal width playback.

widths.range_interpretation: Approximate local climatological major-front separation; no uncertainty interval, seasonal range or pooled 170-500 km interval.
remaining_gates: Recover exact matched contour coordinates and reproduce the meridional separation with product provenance.
Establish dated contour/velocity definitions before monthly or seasonal widths.
Independent scientific admission; no whole-current ranking, route buffer or physical state intersection.
widths.section_orientation: Meridional distance between source-defined MDT contours; not a recovered flow-normal transect.
widths.source_citation: Park, Y.-H. et al. (2019), Observations of the Antarctic Circumpolar Current Over the Udintsev Fracture Zone, the Narrowest Choke Point in the Southern Ocean, JGR Oceans 124, 4511-4528, doi:10.1029/2019JC015024.
